description: This file implements the ControlIpc class and related factory functions for inter-process communication (IPC) in the Rialto client, handling shared memory, client registration, and event subscriptions.

classes.name: ControlIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating ControlIpc instances.

classes.name: ControlIpc
classes.description: Implements IPC communication for control messages, including shared memory retrieval, client registration, and event handling.

methods.name: getControlIpc
methods.description: Creates a ControlIpc instance for a given control client.

methods.name: ControlIpc
methods.description: Constructor for ControlIpc, initializes IPC channel and event thread.

methods.name: ~ControlIpc
methods.description: Destructor for ControlIpc, detaches IPC channel and resets event thread.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Requests shared memory handle and size from the IPC server.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers the client with the IPC server and obtains a control handle.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for IPC communication.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to application state change and ping events.

methods.name: onApplicationStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles application state change events and notifies the control client.

methods.name: onPing
methods.description: Handles ping events, sends acknowledgment if handle matches.
